source.title: Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2 ("County and rural council nominations: four contests in Limavady"); Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2 ("3 critical contests for Unionists in Limavady R.D."); Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6 ("County Londonderry: Limavady - seventeen retiring councillors returned unopposed; the members returned unopposed")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There are no changes regarding the following eighteen outgoing members who are returned unopposed ...' (Derry Journal 21 May 1952 p2; Londonderry Sentinel 22 May 1952 p2). The list gives names and townlands, not divisions.

note: Triennial election of the 23 electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-seven candidates were nominated and four divisions were contested; the Nationalists gained two seats and with them control of the council. Sixteen of the nineteen unopposed members added from the nominations report (Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2; Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2): Ballykelly as the report gives it, the rest from their divisions at the 1949 return. Aghanloo, Feeny and The Highlands (W. J. Thompson, James O'Kane, John Alcorn) are held, as for 1949 (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 2 June 1949 return (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6, which names Dr. MacFlynn for Scriggan); the Derry Journal of 21 May 1952, p. 2, names the member as an outgoing member returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
